_comment: T-330 Hollowed Crypt layout anchors — the single source of truth for where the catacomb's encounters stand. Coords are server WORLD ground (x, y); the crypt geometry (prop_hollowed_crypt.glb) is placed in props.json at (420, 0) in a DISTANT FLAT OFFSET REGION (see gen_hollowed_crypt_real.py's underground-pattern note: T-327 forbids a true y-layer, so the crypt is a roofed box on the flat plain past r~330 where TerrainField.height()==0). world=(420+blender_x, -blender_y). The 3 BOSS anchors are consumed by T-332 (encounters on the T-294 elite chassis); the trash anchors mirror data/instances/hollowed_crypt.json (seeded live by T-331). This file is data-only: no server logic.

bosses.name: The First Warden
bosses.teaching: focus-fire an add (a skeletal warrior it raises)

bosses.name: The Drowned Choir
bosses.teaching: positioning — a ground hazard in the flooded floor

bosses.name: The Hollow King
bosses.lore: T-344: he is patient zero, not just another wight — the first body the Hollowing ever took.

era_rift._comment: T-344 (era-direction.md S7.2): pure foreshadowing seed for the future Era-1 capstone/time-jump quest. NOT interactive and NOT a teleport in Era 1 — flavor text only. Decorative prop (optional) at world (424.3,-45.3), see client/assets/props.json prop_era_rift_monolith (tag hollowed_crypt_vault_rift).
era_rift.description: A sealed, wrong-feeling seam runs up the deepest wall of the Vault, behind where the Hollow King fell. The stone around it is cold in a way frost doesn't explain, and the air near it is a hundred years too old.
era_rift.inspect_flavor: Up close, the seam pulses once — slow, patient, not yet awake. Whatever sealed it here didn't finish the job.
